_comment: Operational settings — PROTOCOL.md §4.2. NOT frozen, NOT part of the git tag, and safe to change mid-window: nothing here can change or steer the outcome. Optional in every sense: the file may be absent, and any key left out falls back to the default in server/runtime.js. Copy to runtime.json only if you need to change something. Pantheon admin credentials do NOT live here — they are environment variables (deploy/README.md §2).
